folds.heading: ## Chronology and evidence scope reconciled, 2026-11-04 (B65)
folds.body: The final visitor section supersedes the earlier unplayed visitor gate for its declared retained-instance fixture: supplied prior progress, actual native exit/re-entry, Save/reload and Export/literal Import. It does not prove natural first onboarding, acquisition pacing, all worlds or exact reference parity. Preserve F1–F17’s distinctions: actual native facts and public time/climate readers, private font availability/rights, fixed glyph advance versus bearing repair, measured responsive minimums, and source-owned transactions remain separate. The reload investigation supports readiness-helper repair rather than a reproduced stuck game loader. Local path history now contains 83bbba0ff and 3ce24d9cb, so earlier uncommitted paragraphs are historical stage records; this review did not verify a current remote push or installed artifact. Historical PIDs/review windows are not current processes or instructions to open them. AD42 makes human taste review optional, while actual changed UI claims retain AD36/AD43 evidence requirements.
